title: Guardians of the Field
description: Dire wolves are trampling Edda's field and rats are in what grain she has stored. Lose this harvest on top of the last one and there is no seed grain for spring. Drive them off.

objectives.description: Kill the dire wolves trampling Edda's field
Kill the rats getting into what grain is left
Tell Edda what is left of her field
Return to Priestess Elara in Dalhurst

notes: Threat: named and compounding - this is the same household from gaela_01 and gaela_02, and a second bad season in a row costs them next year's seed grain, not just this year's food. Giver motive: Elara is protecting a specific family she already sent the player to twice. Consequence: not wired; closes the three-quest arc started in gaela_01.
